hotspots.title: Tisza Party’s presidential pick sparks constitutional crisis
hotspots.blurb: Hungary’s ruling Tisza Party nominated former Supreme Court president András Baka as its presidential candidate, triggering a fierce backlash from Fidesz. The opposition party condemned the move as an illegitimate power grab, vowing to restore constitutional order. The nomination, set for a parliamentary vote on August 11, has deepened political divisions and raised concerns about institutional independence.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to the high-stakes confrontation between Hungary’s ruling and opposition parties, with accusations of constitutional violations and threats to democratic norms.

hotspots.title: Italy-Spain border feud escalates over Ceuta
hotspots.blurb: Italy and Spain are locked in a diplomatic standoff after Italy reinstated Schengen border controls in response to a surge of migrants from Morocco via Ceuta. Spain retaliated by imposing temporary checks on travelers from Italy, escalating tensions within the EU. The dispute has drawn sharp criticism from both governments, with Italy refusing to lift controls despite Spain’s ultimatum.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the high-stakes diplomatic confrontation between two major EU nations, with implications for Schengen’s future and broader EU unity.

hotspots.title: AfD surges ahead of Saxony-Anhalt election
hotspots.blurb: Germany’s far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is leading polls ahead of the September 6 state election in Saxony-Anhalt, raising fears of a potential far-right government. The party’s rise has sparked alarm among mainstream parties, with the CDU ruling out any coalition with the AfD. Concerns about the AfD’s extremist ties and its impact on NATO and EU policies have intensified the political debate.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is highly charged due to the AfD’s potential to form a government in a key German state, threatening democratic norms and EU stability.

The move has reignited debates over immigration and constitutional rights, with critics accusing Trump of undermining long-standing legal precedents. The orders follow a failed attempt to challenge birthright citizenship in the Supreme Court.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is highly charged due to its direct challenge to constitutional norms and its polarizing impact on immigration policy debates.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s diplomatic tour ignites regional tensions
hotspots.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei’s diplomatic tour of Colombia and Ecuador has sparked controversy, particularly after his meeting with Colombia’s new ultra-right president, Abelardo de la Espriella. Milei’s alignment with right-wing leaders in the region has drawn criticism from leftist governments, including Brazil’s Lula da Silva, who accused Milei of undermining Latin American unity. The tour also included a contentious meeting with Spain’s King Felipe VI.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to Milei’s provocative diplomacy, which has heightened regional divisions and drawn international scrutiny.
